cards.source: Hou, "Industry information diffusion and the lead-lag effect in stock returns", RFS 20(4) 2007; Cohen & Lou, "Complicated firms", JFE 2012
cards.data_needed: daily bars, SIC from EDGAR submissions, 8-K items
cards.rule: Buy small/mid stocks lagging their SIC2 industry leaders after a strong leader week; hold a week.

cards.source: Savor, "Stock returns after major price shocks: the impact of information", JFE 106(3) 2012; Chan, "Stock price reaction to news and no-news: drift and reversal after headlines", JFE 70(2) 2003
cards.data_needed: daily bars, Alpaca news flag, 8-K items, earnings dates
cards.rule: Buy the open after a 3-sigma, -5% market-adjusted one-day drop with no news/8-K/earnings; sell 10 sessions later.

cards.source: Blitz, Huij, Lansdorp & Verbeek, "Short-term residual reversal", Journal of Financial Markets 16(3) 2013
cards.rule: Buy the 50 worst one-month factor-neutral residual losers; hold a month.

cards.source: QuantConnect research note "Harvesting the volatility risk premium with a dual VIX signal" (2026); Simon & Campasano, "The VIX futures basis: evidence and trading strategies", J. Derivatives 2014
cards.rule: Hold SVXY at VIX/100 beside SPY when VIX < VIX3M and VIX > 10d realised vol; half when below realised; none in backwardation.
